scope: Direct prerelease replacement proposal after user rejected legacy preservation; no production edits

recommendation.canonical_type: ActionName; optional source-only MethodNumber re-export resolves to same new type/codec
recommendation.encoding: Replace the low-level method encoder/decoder centrally; remove old implementation and old numeric goldens. Update action and event method identities together.
recommendation.schema: One ActionName custom codec; ActionMap and EventMap may continue sharing MethodString and its new numeric identity.
recommendation.accounts: AccountNumber depends on separate NameEncoder path and is unchanged.
recommendation.strings: Supervisor WIT/plugin export names and HTTP methods remain separate string namespaces.
recommendation.parsing: Use strict fallible FromStr/TryFrom-style entry; remove parse-to-zero behavior and convert dynamic boundaries to errors. Source aliases do not preserve infallible invalid-string semantics.
recommendation.numeric_transport: Carry exact u64 through central Transact path; typed callers should not debug-string-reencode. Headerless text APIs can keep canonical strings and use the single current codec.
recommendation.development: Rebuild generated bindings/schemas/permissions and reset development chain when model generation changes; one model fingerprint across build outputs. No old/new per-service negotiation or activation/history machinery.
